Who We Serve

We serve clients when the stakes are high.

UOA Legal is not a volume practice. We are a precision practice. That means we are selective about the matters we take — and fully committed to the ones we accept.

The clients who find the most value in working with us share one thing in common: their legal matter has real consequences, and they know it.

Entrepreneurs & Founders

You're building something. A structural flaw now — a bad cap table, a missing clause, an overlooked liability — can become the reason it doesn't survive. We build the legal infrastructure that lets you scale with confidence.

Executives & Senior Professionals

Your career, reputation, and mobility are assets. Employment disputes, compliance exposure, and litigation risk can threaten all three simultaneously. We protect them with the same precision you've applied to building them.

Multinational Companies & Cross-Border Operators

Operating across jurisdictions without the right legal scaffolding is one of the fastest ways to create liability. We bring U.S., Nigerian, and international cross-border experience to clients who need to operate without exposure.

High-Net-Worth Individuals

Your matters are high-stakes. They require counsel who treats them that way — with the discretion, strategic depth, and senior-level attention your situation demands. Not a form. Not a junior associate. Counsel.

Diaspora Investors & Cross-Border Wealth Builders

Building wealth across borders — across currencies, legal systems, and tax regimes — requires more than a lawyer. It requires an advisor who understands the full architecture of what you're constructing and can protect it from every angle.

We are not the right firm for every matter.
We are the right firm when the stakes are high.
